comment: Written for gEdit (synthetic, not for a machine); see README.md here.
description: Siemens two channels: channel 1 jumps with GOTOF SKIP1 over its WAITM(2,1,2); channel 2 waits on mark 3 before mark 2. The jump lines do not read a jump to a label (computeJumpLines takes no label target), so the written order was out of order. Followed, channel 1 never runs mark 2: channel 2 waits for it for ever, reported as missing.
